issue_headline: BLINDFOLDS AND BENCHES: WEEK 7’S ELITE BUNGLES
issue_deck: Pop Lockett Drop it and Buttermilk Puuump carve their names into the self-sabotage hall of fame, while ThreatLevelMidnight drops the hammer on Uncle Rico.

lead_story.headline: THE ART OF THE THROW: HOW TO LEAVE WINS ON THE PINE
body: In a league where margins are razor-thin, Week 7 offered a masterclass in how to gift-wrap a victory and hand it to your opponent with a bow. Pop Lockett Drop it and Buttermilk Puuump decided that actually winning close games was far too mainstream, opting instead for architectural masterpieces in roster mismanagement.

Pop Lockett Drop it managed to drop a 6.00-point decision to Joe Mantegna while leaving 11.50 points languishing on the bench, specifically keeping KC Concepcion Jr. warming pine while Kenneth Walker III scrounged up stats. Meanwhile, Buttermilk Puuump continued a season-long masterclass in futility by coughing up a 3.44-point loss to malle_dips_pouches, thanks to 7.54 unused bench points that could easily have rescued a 4.10-point victory.

matchup_recaps.headline: A 3.44-Point Miracle Built Entirely on Bench Warmers
matchup_recaps.body: malle_dips_pouches escaped with a 112.32 to 108.88 win over Buttermilk Puuump, though their lineup execution was nothing to write home about—leaving a whopping 23.6 points on the bench, highlighted by Jalen Coker and Garrett Wilson taking up space while Michael Wilson and Caleb Douglas outscored them from the pine. Buttermilk Puuump returned the favor by benching Malik Willis and Hunter Henry for Dak Prescott and Mark Andrews.

matchup_recaps.headline: The 90.48-Point Grind That Defied All-Play Logic
matchup_recaps.body: Patty Primetimes scraped together a 90.48 to 86.22 victory against Malle ❤️ 🐸, proving that you do not need to score many points to secure a win when luck is on your side. With an expected win rate of just 0.1818, Patty Primetimes managed to snap a three-game losing skid despite benching Harold Fannin Jr. for Isaiah Likely.

matchup_recaps.headline: Voldemort Slays The Big Gronkowski in a Brutal All-Play Heartbreak
matchup_recaps.body: The Big Gronkowski put up the week's 3rd-highest score at 126.24 points, only to run smack into Voldemort's 131.52-point surge. Despite near-flawless 99.92% lineup efficiency, The Big Gronkowski suffered a brutal bad beat, while Voldemort quietly capitalized with a 9.4-point bench cushion anchored by keeping Makai Lemon off the starting squad.

matchup_recaps.headline: Joe Mantegna Survives the Bench-Grief of Pop Lockett Drop it
matchup_recaps.body: Joe Mantegna posted a pristine 100% efficiency rating to squeeze past Pop Lockett Drop it 121.22 to 115.22. The flawless execution stood in stark contrast to Pop Lockett Drop it's self-inflicted wound of benching KC Concepcion Jr. in favor of Kenneth Walker III.

matchup_recaps.headline: Post Mahomes Stumbles Into a Win as Ginger FC 🏆🏆 Crumbles
matchup_recaps.body: Post Mahomes captured a 103.5 to 72.22 victory over Ginger FC 🏆🏆 despite a meager 0.2727 expected win rate. Ginger FC 🏆🏆 saw its three-game winning streak snapped in a dismal offensive showing, capped by starting C.J. Stroud over Bo Nix.

matchup_recaps.headline: ThreatLevelMidnight Hammers Uncle Rico to Cement Franchise Milestone
matchup_recaps.body: ThreatLevelMidnight rolled out the week's high score of 155.18 points to demolish Uncle Rico's 103.6-point effort. The massive 51.58-point blowout handed franchise manager their 75th career win, while Uncle Rico's lineup choices—starting Keenan Allen and Nico Collins over Chris Godwin Jr. and Braelon Allen—added 14.9 points of regret to a miserable afternoon.

managerial_desk.headline: The Anatomy of Left-Behind Points and Avoidable Starts
managerial_desk.body: malle_dips_pouches took home the dubious honor of worst managerial decision of the week, leaving a staggering 23.6 points on the bench behind an 82.64% efficiency rate. Starting Jalen Coker and Garrett Wilson while Michael Wilson and Caleb Douglas sat idle cost them a cleaner afternoon, though they still managed a win. At the other end of the spectrum, Joe Mantegna and Malle ❤️ 🐸 were the only squads to achieve a spotless 100.0% lineup efficiency, while The Big Gronkowski missed perfection by a microscopic 0.1 points.

luck_report.headline: All-Play Atrocity: The Big Gronkowski and Pop Lockett Drop it Get Robbed
luck_report.body: The luck ledger was thoroughly lopsided in Week 7. The Big Gronkowski posted 126.24 points—good for the 3rd-highest rank in the league—only to pick up a brutal loss against Voldemort, despite boasting an 0.8182 expected win rate and 9 all-play wins. Pop Lockett Drop it suffered a similar fate with 7 all-play wins falling short against Joe Mantegna. Conversely, Patty Primetimes and Post Mahomes posted all-play win totals of just 2 and 3 respectively, proving that it is better to be lucky than good.

players_of_the_week.headline: ThreatLevelMidnight Carries the Scoring Crown
players_of_the_week.body: ThreatLevelMidnight lapped the field in Week 7, pacing all franchises with an imposing 155.18 points behind a 91.24% efficient lineup. At the opposite end, Ginger FC 🏆🏆 hit rock bottom with a league-low 72.22 points, unable to overcome a stagnant roster.

record_book.headline: ThreatLevelMidnight Joins the 75-Win Club
record_book.body: Milestones fell as ThreatLevelMidnight secured career win number 75 in dominant fashion over Uncle Rico. Meanwhile, three-game winning streaks came to a grinding halt for Ginger FC 🏆🏆 and Pop Lockett Drop it, while Malle ❤️ 🐸 saw its two-game run snapped. Patty Primetimes, ThreatLevelMidnight, and malle_dips_pouches finally broke free from their respective skids.

previews.body: History favors Voldemort, who holds a 7-4 historical edge over Uncle Rico across 11 prior meetings with 1270.32 points for and 1218.84 against. The projection model paints a dead-even picture, forecasting 89.86 for Voldemort and 90.17 for Uncle Rico.

previews.body: History favors ThreatLevelMidnight, who holds an 8-2 historical edge over Joe Mantegna across 10 prior meetings with 1119.88 points against and 1012.66 for. The projection model likes ThreatLevelMidnight again at 107.81 to Joe Mantegna's 95.07.

previews.body: History favors Pop Lockett Drop it, who holds an 8-7 historical edge over Ginger FC 🏆🏆 across 15 prior meetings, leading 1633.36 to 1570.82 in total points. The model projects Pop Lockett Drop it ahead at 122.35 to 104.00.

previews.body: History favors malle_dips_pouches, who holds a 6-3 historical edge over Patty Primetimes across 9 prior meetings, outscoring them 1021.1 to 976.26. The projection model views this one as a dead heat, slating malle_dips_pouches at 121.29 and Patty Primetimes at 121.25.

closing_shot: If your bench outscores your starting lineup by 23.6 points, maybe stop letting your cat set your roster.
